The '''CSS-1 Corellian Star Shuttle''', also known as the '''Republic shuttle''', was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] designed to carry a large number of ambassadors on missions throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:Republic_Shuttle.png|thumb|left|250px|Newly elected Chancellor Palpatine's Star Shuttle ''Perpetuus'' arrives on Naboo.]]
The CSS-1 Corellian Star Shuttle was more spacious and could carry more people compared to the [[Consular-class light cruiser/Legends|''Consular''-class cruiser]]. It also featured a large meeting room. Because they were diplomatic vessels, Star Shuttles lacked weapons but boasted a powerful [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]].

The class was manufactured by the famous [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]], which manufactured most of the vessels in use by the Galactic Republic. They were less versatile than most CEC designs, in part due to their extensive armor plating.

The [[Transport/Legends|transport]] had a crew of one [[Captain/Legends|captain]], two co-[[Pilot/Legends|pilots]], two communications officers, and three engineers. It could also carry about 200 passengers and 900 metric tons.

==History==
Star Shuttles served the Republic in its last decades as diplomatic vessels, but some ships were modified for military service and were equipped with at least two [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]]. They served in the [[Judicial Forces/Legends|Judicial Forces]] and fought in the [[Stark Hyperspace War/Legends|Stark Hyperspace War]], the [[Yinchorri Uprising]], and the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The Corellian Star Shuttle [[Perpetuus/Legends|''Perpetuus'']] transported Chancellor Palpatine to [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] following the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]].
[[File:Republic_Outland_Regions_Security_Force.png|thumb|220x220px|Modified CSS-1's participating in the Stark Hyperspace War]]
After the transformation of the Republic into an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], many Star Shuttles ended up in private hands.<ref name="SOTG01">''[[Starships of the Galaxy]]''</ref> At least one Star Shuttle was used to make up a [[Hidden Temple (Sith–Imperial War)|secret retreat]] in [[137 ABY]].<ref name="SWL25">[[Legacy (2006) 25|''Legacy'' (2006) 25]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
On his blog, [[Daniel Wallace|Dan Wallace]] revealed that [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] shuttle was named [[Perpetuus/Legends|''Perpetuus'']] in ''[[The Essential Guide to Episode I]]''. However, since the book was never released, the name is not official.<ref name="Blog-danwallace|34">{{Blog|danwallace|34|Lostwords: The Essential Guide to Episode I}}</ref> ''[[Suns of Fortune]]'' gave the Corellian Star Shuttle the full name of "CSS-1 Corellian Star Shuttle," although it misspelled it as CCS-8 in one location.<ref name="SOF">''[[Suns of Fortune]]''</ref>
